description: React component for logged-in user interface handling WebSocket initialization, user activity, focus/blur events, navigation redirects for MFA and Terms of Service, and desktop app interactions.

classes.name: LoggedIn
classes.description: React component managing user session, focus, activity, and navigation for logged-in users.

methods.name: isValidState
methods.description: Checks if currentUser prop is not null.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes WebSocket, sets up event listeners, fetches user profile attributes, and handles device-specific setup.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and WebSocket connection.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders loading, redirects for MFA or TOS, or children components based on state.

methods.name: updateTimeZone
methods.description: Updates user's timezone based on browser settings.

methods.name: onFocusListener
methods.description: Handles window focus event, updates timezone and focus state.

methods.name: onBlurListener
methods.description: Handles window blur event, updates focus state.

methods.name: updateActiveStatus
methods.description: Updates user activity status via WebSocket.

methods.name: clickNotification
methods.description: Handles notification click, focuses window and navigates to channel.

methods.name: handleBackSpace
methods.description: Prevents backspace navigation in non-input elements.

methods.name: handleBeforeUnload
methods.description: Handles cleanup before page unload, updates view time, and closes WebSocket.
